name: maintenance_work_mem
description: Specifies the maximum amount of memory to be used by maintenance operations, such as VACUUM, CREATE INDEX, and ALTER TABLE ADD FOREIGN KEY.
tuning_tips: Larger settings perform maintenance tasks like VACUUM and CREATE INDEX faster. Since these are not frequent operations, you can set this much higher than work_mem.
official_snippet: It is safe to set this much larger than work_mem, because only a few of these operations can run at the same time.
